title: Database work
description: A PostgreSQL and a Redis of their own beside the agent, at localhost:5432 and localhost:6379, gone with the run; PyPI, npm and GitHub open.

de.title: Datenbankarbeit
de.description: Ein eigenes PostgreSQL und ein eigenes Redis neben dem Agenten, unter localhost:5432 und localhost:6379, mit dem Lauf wieder weg; PyPI, npm und GitHub offen.

postgres.label: Your PostgreSQL image (sandbox-ai images list)
postgres.hint: once: sandbox-ai images pull docker.io/library/postgres:17-bookworm --as postgres

redis.label: Your Redis image (sandbox-ai images list); empty: no Redis
redis.hint: once: sandbox-ai images pull docker.io/library/redis:7-alpine --as redis

notes: Pull the images once (pinned by digest, marked UNCHECKED: nobody reviewed them): sandbox-ai images pull docker.io/library/postgres:17-bookworm --as postgres, sandbox-ai images pull docker.io/library/redis:7-alpine --as redis.

The services share the sandbox's network: whatever they send meets its firewall, connection proxy and approvals. They run without capabilities, with a read-only root and their data in memory (gone with the run; keep=yes in the --service value keeps it with the start). The agent connects with postgresql://dev:dev@localhost:5432/dev (the password is a development one, never a secret of yours) and redis://localhost:6379.
user=999:999 is the postgres user of the official Debian image (the Alpine one has 70), 999:1000 Redis's: the image's own entry point cannot change its user without capabilities.
Podman only (a service is a container in the sandbox's pod); refused behind Tor and in the security mode paranoid.
Pushes: a login during the run (sandbox-ai net allow --git-token-env ...) or the push proxy.
